title: Monitorable-by-design architectures for a post-Astra world: a compartmentalization-based approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.31610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier models like GPT-6 Astra are increasingly able to do substantial reasoning without a monitorable chain of thought, chains of thought are becoming less legible, and are often monitored asynchronously to reduce cost. With the future of chain of thought monitoring unclear, it may be necessary to design LLMs with monitorability in mind. We propose a modification to existing LLM architectures based on GRAM, SGTM, DEMix, BTS, and similar methods to compartmentalize dangerous capabilities so that their use, especially in combination with dangerous reasoning types that may indicate strategic adversarial use, can be monitored more cheaply than chain of thought in a way that might outlast monitorable chain of thought. We propose several variants of this architecture designed to balance tradeoffs and discuss other benefits, such as capability removal.

translated_title: 面向后Astra时代的可监控性设计架构：一种基于隔离化的方法
translated_abstract: 像GPT-6 Astra这样的前沿模型越来越能够在没有可监控思维链的情况下进行大量推理，思维链正变得愈发难以解读，并且为了降低成本常常被异步监控。由于思维链监控的未来尚不明朗，可能有必要在设计大语言模型时就考虑到可监控性。我们提出了一种对现有LLM架构的改进方案，该方案基于GRAM、SGTM、DEMix、BTS及类似方法，对危险能力进行隔离化处理，使其使用——尤其是与可能表明策略性对抗性使用的危险推理类型相结合时——能够以比思维链监控更廉价的方式进行监控，且这种监控方式可能比可监控思维链存续得更久。我们提出了该架构的若干变体，旨在平衡各种权衡取舍，并讨论了其他好处，例如能力移除。
tldr: 提出一种基于隔离化的LLM架构改进方案，通过将危险能力分区隔离，使其使用（尤其是可能预示策略性对抗行为的危险推理）能够以比思维链监控更低成本、且在可监控思维链失效后仍然有效的方式进行监控。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a compartmentalization-based modification to LLM architectures that isolates dangerous capabilities, enabling their use—especially strategic adversarial use—to be monitored more cheaply than chain-of-thought monitoring and in a way that may outlast monitorable chain of thought.
